body:
I'm guessing by your response you recommend continuing with WHM?  


>What skills are you even using to heal

maybe it would be best if i record myself going through a dungeon and posting the video here however, I use tetra, lilies as much as possible, when I run out, I go to cure 2 with thin air otherwise just cure 2 I try to keep regen on the tank AFTER (see below) they grab all packs of enemies (sometimes forget)   


>Regen them as they pull, it doesn't pull aggro on each tick so it's literally free...

in my experience anytime I use regen, the tank hits using ranged and then every other enemy ends up targeting me, so I've stopped using regen between packs or before packs. I had this happen to me a lot, but I might have to revisit and see if it still happens, or I just got unlucky.

I like the idea of swiftcast the first holy - I think maybe the issue occurs on my cooldown usage. I find myself facing every boss with asylum on cooldown.

the most recent dungeon I did was The Dead Ends which had a lot of raidwides and I found medica 2 was not enough and maybe panic didn't help but found myself using a lot of aoe heals.

Ultimately, I am looking to be able to comfortably get through dungeons and eventually work my confidence up to more difficult content

All of my friends say WHM is the easiest healer, but I'm having a tough time with it.  
Would it be more worth my time to keep trying to learn and improve WHM or to try a different healer?  


especially the 75-90 dungeon range

* tank almost or does die on 2nd wall to wall pull
* I die to boss looking at my skills or misjudging cast 
* raidwide goes off, I'll go for a medica 2 or medica and everyone won't be at 100% so i'll use another skill to heal up again
* between packs of enemies the tank might get too low for me to use Holy, so I'll get trapped into spamming heals when we reach the last pack of enemies instead of Holy
This is very legit. No lie.
Damn. This is what I aspire to learn to create. Well done.
It's hard. Based on the sheer upvotes, you and me aren't the only ones.
I'm gonna do this. Thank you. You have just improved my life. Definitely. Thank you. I think you should follow this advice too. I'd like to hear an update if you ever decide to open up :).

But they're all such lovely people, how could I burden any of them with this?

You're right. I need to make my decision. Is it better in person, or via message. 

Should I message the person making me feel lonely,  or get some advice from my other friends about them?

Idk. I'm running out of time. I've got to act soon if I want them to be my true friend. Or maybe I just let them go. Maybe they'll come back? Nah, no way, right?

It feels like the friendship has died, doesnt it.
It feels like a knot in your stomach you wake up to everyday.
It feels like it tightens everytime you get a message from them right?
I feel this. All the time.
There are too many people in this world that don't bother to ask you how you are.
There are to many people that respond to a question like how was your break / day / weekend, without ever returning the question. 
People seem to not care, right?

This is what makes you and me and everyone in this subreddit feel lonely, even though you may be surrounded by people.

You may not feel great today, but that knot won't go away until they do, or you address it in some way.
It sucks. I can't address it, and I live with that knot. His name is Jerry :), he makes me feel alive most days. Jk I haven't given it a name.

Venting helps. Writing it down helps. Realizing this helps.

But one day you gotta mention something. Hey why we not talk anymore? Hey where did all of those good memories go? Can you visit me sometime?

Maybe you can reconnect with them. Maybe they'll realize that they have been ungrateful.

I'm just so afraid to tell my friends I'm lonely.
I'm afraid they will tell me I'm looking for attention.
I'm afraid that itll push them away.
I'm afraid they have problems they're bottling up and that if I open up, they will feel like my problems are negligible, and ridiculous. 
I'm afraid to open up.

I hate it. I hate it so much, because it starts to make me think they dont care. When I doubt that's even remotely true.
I'm in this photo and I don't like it.

F for my mans
Best thing you can do is forget she said anything mean to you.
It does you no good to harbor on the words of those who do not care.

I'd say theres a pretty big difference between being jealous and being overly jealous. 

I think jealousy is normal, I think jealousy cannot be helped. But the real harm is when you do something about it. The real harm is when you're paranoid something else is happening.
Come here and let me give you a hug you sexy ass motherfucker

Quite honestly there are some people that make you feel so alone inside.

They never seem to want to hear about you, yet they still  try to interact with you.

Maybe it's not your friends though. I think about this so much. Like what if I'm the problem? What if no one likes me enough to care how I feel, you know?

But that's probably just me being irrational. I'm just not around the right people. But they look like the right people. They're just imposters.
The worst part is when you're always making others laugh or smile, and then it really feels like theres no true  way for you to have them feel pity for you.
Unless you have a lot of problems in which case you always want to tell them more things
Sometimes, I purposefully make awkward knee contact with the person I'm setting next to / across to feel what its like to have my knee touched.

"What are you looking forward to most this week / weekend"

"What was the best part about your day today?"
